body:
## Summary

Travel booking data is not detected: airline booking references (PNR / record locator), e-ticket numbers and visa or e-visa application numbers. In a real leak, a booking reference and airline notification identifiers were published from sanitized sessions.

## Reproduction (synthetic data)

```js
const s = createSanitizer();
for (const t of [
  'booking reference K7QWZP',
  'PNR: XKJHQZ, record locator XKJHQZ',
  'код брони K7QWZP',
  'e-ticket 098-2401234567',
  'e-visa registration code E260512ABCDEF',
]) console.log((await s.sanitize(t)).text);
// None are redacted.
```

## Expected

- `BOOKING_REFERENCE`: 5–8 alphanumeric characters after context words (booking reference/code, reservation code, confirmation code, record locator, PNR, код брони, номер брони, бронирование).
- `TICKET_NUMBER`: 13-digit IATA e-ticket numbers (3-digit airline prefix + 10 digits) with context.
- `VISA_NUMBER`: visa / e-visa / registration numbers after context words.
- Personal category, so masking transformations apply.

## Tests

Negatives must include ordinary uppercase words after "booking" (for example `booking reference: NONE`) and git short SHAs.
title: Detect travel booking data: PNR/booking references, e-ticket and visa numbers
